old: A ketone flanked by two intact cyclopentyl groups would need a hydride shift, but neither carbinol carbon has a hydrogen.
new: Dicyclopentyl ketone has 11 carbons, but the diol has only 10; a rearrangement cannot add a carbon. The real product keeps all ten carbons, with one ring expanded from five to six.
why: choice C (O=C(C1CCCC1)C1CCCC1) is C11H18O vs diol C10H18O2 (RDKit); stored feedback gives a wrong reason
